campaign_name: ATGB-03A Provider Accounting Safety and Continuation Readiness
purpose: Investigate accounting and continue only if request usage can be bounded safely.
objective_status: SAFETY CORRECTION VALIDATED; UPPER BOUND UNRESOLVED; LIVE CONTINUATION STOPPED
executive_summary: 45 provider-disabled tests passed. Three production ledger coverage gaps prevent a safe upper bound. Benchmark entry points now refuse before live dispatch. No new live trials or requests; original 15/37 captured turns preserved. Human scoring pending. User's explicit stop condition applied; full accounting repair and live baseline remain incomplete.

production: None; source hashes match original execution.
validation: 21 new accounting checks plus 24 existing infrastructure/readiness checks passed.
tooling: ATGB-03A-1 ledger observation/reconciliation and fail-closed readiness gate in runner and direct worker.
documentation: Root-cause report, current session orientation, distinct-trial continuation plan.
generated_artifacts: Coverage audit, preservation hashes, original raw metadata, usage/latency summaries, unchanged human worksheets and transcripts.

testing.broader: Existing provider-disabled chat and all-scenario reset checks included in 45.
testing.runtime_validation: No additional live execution; original baseline remains partial.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Original OpenAI gpt-4.1-mini configuration preserved; zero new live calls.
testing.new_regressions: None observed in focused scope; live execution intentionally unavailable until accounting is reliable.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Host telemetry missing/incomplete scope; completion-ledger coverage gaps. Interrupted sandbox TestClient attempt retained as environmental limitation.

campaign_specific: Reliable universal request upper bound remains unresolved; live continuation refused.
No supported S04.3 resume continuity; future S04 requires a separate full trial.
pre_existing: Original host counters omit expression usage; S04.2 performance absent.
Ledger does not cover all dispatch owners and unfinished attempts.
Dirty worktree, previously exposed held-out corpus, unavailable dollar costs/SDK retry counts.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Review the fail-closed safety correction and established accounting coverage limitations. No gameplay change proposed.
Human-score original captured conversations only; retain pending/not-evaluated until authorized judgments are supplied.
missing_concepts: Reliable dispatch lifecycle accounting across provider owners within an approved scope.
Validated resume/checkpoint continuity; complete live baseline and human scoring.
does_not_prove: Complete accounting repair or full live baseline completion.
Zero provider use from absent host telemetry, or exact turn attribution from an untagged ledger.
Gameplay improvement, semantic success, S07/S09 opening delivery, independent generalization, dollar cost, or SDK-internal retry totals.
recommended_next_step: Await review. Do not bypass guard or start gameplay/Product Realization repairs. If separately resolved, rerun S04 as trial 2 and execute S05–S10 with proven request allowance and fresh explicit deadlines, preserving S01–S03 and original partial S04.
